name: sidc_codes
title: Recorded 2525D code list (data/sidc_codes.csv)
description: Reference copy (roadmap 410, 23 November 2026) of the entity and modifier codes of MIL-STD-2525D symbol sets 10 (Land Unit), 30 (Sea Surface) and 35 (Sea Subsurface), flattened from the JMSML instance files (github.com/Esri/joint-military-symbology-xml, branch dev, commit 094e7647f0bd, 19 September 2024), with the icon key milsymbol (v3.0.6, src/numbersidc) uses for each code (blank where milsymbol has none). scripts/validate.py checks every code of data/sidc_function_map.csv against it. Not hand-edited except to add a newly verified code.

fields.name: milsymbol_icon
fields.description: The milsymbol icon key for the code; blank when milsymbol has no entry (for example 000000 Unspecified, drawn as an empty frame).
